title: Primal Stampede
html:
Primal Stampede is a Wildheart barbarian class action only available while using  Rage: Elk Heart, allowing you charge in a line dealing damage to all enemies and knocking them prone.

Description

Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them  Prone.

Available only when  Raging.

Does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Properties

Cost
 Action +  Movement Speed
Damage: 1~4 + modifiers
1d4 + Strength modifier⁠Bludgeoning
Details
 Melee Unarmed Attack Roll
 STR Save (DC 10 + Strength modifier)
 AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Line
 Targets: All non-allied creatures in the path

Technical details

UID
Rush_Primal_Stampede
Spell flags
AddFallDamageOnLand, CanAreaDamageEvade, IsHarmful

Condition: Prone

 Prone

Duration: 2 turns

 STR Save (DC 10 + Strength modifier)

  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • A Prone creature must spend half its  Movement Speed to stand up.
  • Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
  • If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 3: Wildheart

Granted by spells:

  •  Rage: Elk Heart

Notes

  • Hits all enemies, friendly NPCs, and objects within a 2 m (7 ft) radius along the charge path.
  • This action triggers  Extra Attack and can be used with Extra Attack.
  • Primal Stampede is coded as a melee, unarmed attack. However, rather than using the typical UnarmedDamage variable, Primal Stampede does a fixed 1d4 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage. Because of this, various other effects may not behave as expected.
    • Items and features that add a bonus to melee unarmed attack rolls apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include the attack roll components of  Tavern Brawler and the  Gloves of Crushing. Items and features that add a bonus to all attack rolls also apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include the attack roll components of  Legacy of the Masters and  Mutilated Carapace.
    • Items and features that add a bonus to unarmed damage do not apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include, ironically, the  Rage: Elk Heart damage bonus as well as the damage components of Tavern Brawler and the Gloves of Crushing. Items and features that add a damage bonus to all (relevant) damage do apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include the  Shadow-Cloaked Ring,  Overloaded With Synaptic Power (from  Psionic Overload), and the damage component of Mutilated Carapace.
    • Whether other non-attack-roll, non-damage-bonus effects apply to Primal Stampede depends upon how they are coded. To apply to Primal Stampede, the effect either needs to be so general that it would apply to any type of attack or damage, or it needs to apply to melee unarmed attacks without checking for unarmed damage.
      • Examples include: the  Bleeding effect from the  Helldusk Gloves, because that effect applies whenever you deal damage; the  Soul Catching effect (but not the damage bonus) from the  Gloves of Soul Catching, because that effect applies whenever you deal damage with an unarmed attack; and accumulating  Lightning Charges from  The Sparkle Hands, because that effect applies to all unarmed attacks that hit.
